authority_basis.summary: Continue deriving or falsifying the source-derived Mellin-dilation Xi boundary and add the result to the ledger.

operations.title: Entry 1402 — The Xi Jet Filtration Canonically Restores Spectral Multiplicity
operations.summary: The maximal-ideal associated graded of the CCM/Xi local quotient canonically kills Jordan nilpotents while retaining zero order as fiber dimension. Under RH its square-sum completion has a self-adjoint compact-resolvent operator with determinant Xi/Xi(0), but the Weil form does not yet supply independent jet channels.

operations.title: The Xi jet associated graded canonically semisimplifies with multiplicity
operations.statement: At a zero lambda of order m, the local quotient O_lambda/(Xi) has m one-dimensional maximal-ideal graded pieces. Multiplication by z induces lambda on each piece. Their square-sum completion therefore gives a multiplicity-preserving diagonal compact-resolvent operator, self-adjoint exactly under RH, with symmetric det_2 equal to Xi/Xi(0).
operations.scope: Algebraic source quotient and conditional Hilbertization; the norm and independent jet channels are not derived from the scalar Weil pairing.

operations.title: Double-zero Weil-to-jet rank falsifier
operations.description: At a double zero, compare the rank-one scalar Weil evaluation form 2|G(lambda)|^2 with the two-dimensional associated-graded determinant fiber. Any full isometry requires a second source-derived jet channel.
